name: Elderline - National Helpline for Senior Citizens
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_group: Senior citizens seeking information, support, guidance or grievance assistance
eligibility: Senior citizens can seek assistance through the national helpline service.
benefits: Information, guidance, emotional support and linkage/referral to appropriate services.
documents: Basic caller information; additional documents only if required for a referred service
source: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Government of India
